thread.title: Berkshire Hathaway ups Apple stake, shifts airline holdings - MarketWatch

author: Wallace Witkowski
title: Berkshire Hathaway ups Apple stake, shifts airline holdings - MarketWatch

organizations.name: bank of new york mellon corp

text:
Berkshire Hathaway Inc. BRK.A, +0.19% BRK.B, +0.32% said it loaded up on shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.42% while trimming its stake in American Airlines Group Inc. AAL, +0.82% according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission late Tuesday. Berkshire also added to positions of Bank of New York Mellon Corp. BK, +1.66% Delta Air Lines Inc. DAL, +1.00% Southwest Airlines Co. LUV, +0.42% and General Motors Co. GM, +0.11% Berkshire reduced its stake in Phillips 66 PSX, -0.52% United Continental Holdings Inc. UAL, +0.28% and Wells Fargo & Co. WFC, +0.80%
